title: Sierra Leone Business Registry Name Search

businessName.title: Business name to search
businessName.description: A single business/company name (or fragment, minimum 3 characters) to search for in Sierra Leone's OARG registry.

businessNames.title: Business names to search
businessNames.description: Multiple business/company names (or fragments) to search for in one run.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Caps how many matching business names are pushed to the dataset per query. The registry has no server-side result limit, so a broad/common query can match thousands of names (e.g. "TRADING" matches ~2,000) -- this truncates the OUTPUT only (the full response is still downloaded and parsed either way). _totalMatches on each record shows how many actually matched.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many queries to run in parallel.
